title.narrative: PERSEUS: Promoting Efficiency of Ministry of Internal Affairs through Human Resources Management Reform

description.narrative: The Project is built on the consolidated achievements from past and ongoing initiatives funded by the US/INL, EU, WB, and other international development partners. It focuses on strengthening the institutional capacities of the Police and the Ministry of Internal Affairs, enhancing effectiveness, and introducing new possibilities for development. The project facilitates knowledge exchange between relevant institutions and other countries that have undergone successful HRM reforms, and the lessons learnt are heavily considered. The Project also relies on the best practices from the successful partnership of the INL and UNDP globally to promote HRM reform in the MOIA and the Police in Armenia. The project is designed with a focus on sustainability beyond the projects duration: UNDP hopes to leave a lasting impact on the ministrys HRM practices and systems.
